name: Demetrius
overview: The name Demetrius appears in Scripture referring to two distinct individuals. One is a silversmith in Ephesus who, concerned about his craft and livelihood tied to making silver shrines for the goddess Diana, led a significant riot against Paul’s teachings that challenged the worship of idols (Acts 19:24-29). This incident highlights the tension between the gospel and prevailing pagan practices. Another Demetrius is a Christian commended in 3 John 1:12, illustrating a faithful believer recognized for his good testimony within the early church.
